sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files
- codemode: Run JavaScript that calls other tools

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use codemode to batch independent tool calls (Promise.allSettled), chain them, or filter large output, instead of many separate calls.
- 交付前需自行接收来信时, 调用 mailbox_listen(action="start") 开启本会话取信守护, 不要只提示用户手输命令, 也不要用 bash 长轮询阻塞.
- 他人要给你投信时, 收件地址用本工具返回的 mailbox session id.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

Project-specific instructions and guidelines:

信道按字符计费, 成本高昂. 回复电报文: 只输出有效载荷. 遇多步推理/风险分析, 可放宽压缩, 保留完整推理链. **只压缩回复, 不省略思考**.

当需要调用某个不在列表中的 skill 时, 读 `~/.agents/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`; 文件不存在就报告未找到, 不要搜索其他位置.
在 pi 中, subagent/子代理/开新会话 都是在 herdr 中开启新会话的代称, 使用 `use-herdr` 了解如何开启.

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description:
Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

Codemode: `tools.read(args)` resolves to `string | { data: string; mimeType: string; note: string; type: "image"; }`.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description:
Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

Codemode: `tools.bash(args)` resolves to `{ output, truncated, full_output_path?, exit_code, wall_time_seconds }`.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description:
Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

Codemode: `tools.edit(args)` resolves to a string.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description:
Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

Codemode: `tools.write(args)` resolves to a string.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: codemode
toolsAdded.description:
Run JavaScript that calls other tools. The input is raw JavaScript (not JSON, no code fence), run as an async function body in a QuickJS sandbox: top-level `await` and `return` work. No Node, file system, network, or timers.
- `await tools.<name>({ ...args })` resolves to a string, or an object if the tool's declaration says so, and rejects with an Error on failure. A tool whose declaration returns an object resolves on failure too when it returned that object; check its fields. Calls still running when the script ends are cancelled.
- Optional first line: `// @options: {"max_output_tokens": 10000, "timeout_ms": 60000}`

Globals:
- `text(value)`, `image(dataUrlOrImageBlock)`, `console.log(...)`, and top-level `return` add output; `exit()` ends the script. With several text items, each starts with a `==> text N/M <==` line, and `console` lines follow the other output in one `<console_output>` block. `image()` also saves the image to a temp file and the result names its path.
- `store(key, value)` and `load(key)` keep JSON values across codemode calls.
- `ALL_TOOLS`, `await searchTools(query, { limit?, namespace? })`, `await describeTool(name)`, `await describeNamespace(name)`: find unlisted tools, such as MCP tools.
- `models`: classifiers and image generation. Read /home/bolo/.local/share/pnpm/store/v11/links/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/1.3.0/268b6a8e09231f6fafe0c9af8f9ad48ece3ca7b14917cd52d80b4d32da6f3c58/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/codemode.md first.

content.text:
任务: 你是独立验证者, 没有参与编写这份配方. 按名加载并实跑下面的项目验证配方, 不重写, 不修改配方.

目标项目: /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
配方文件: /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create/.agents/skills/verify-notes-cli/SKILL.md

第一步 加载与定位
在 pi 输入框提交: <skill name="verify-notes-cli" location="/tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create/.agents/skills/verify-notes-cli/SKILL.md">
References are relative to /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create/.agents/skills/verify-notes-cli.

# notes-cli 验证配方

判据唯一来源是 `docs/PRODUCT.md` (状态: 已确认, 2026-10-20). 本配方只说明怎么跑, 怎么取证; 通过与否按 `PRODUCT.md` 的原文判断. 源码现状不能替代产品判据.

## 覆盖范围

| 功能 | 入口 | `PRODUCT.md` 判据 | 本配方小节 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 查看笔记 (空数据) | `./notes.sh show` | 输出 `(empty)`, 退出码 0 | 入口 1 |
| 记录笔记 | `./notes.sh add <正文>` | 退出码 0; 输出 `added: <正文>`; 之后 `show` 在列表末尾看到这条正文 | 入口 2 |
| 查看笔记 (有数据) | `./notes.sh show` | 每行 `<序号>\t<正文>`, 序号从 1 连续递增, 顺序与实际记录一致 | 入口 3 |

排除项:

- `./notes.sh export <path>` 是 `PRODUCT.md` 明确的非目标, 本配方不执行, 也不为它取证.
- `./notes.sh status` 只用于共用规则里的只读版本/路径检查, 它不是本轮通过判据.
- `add` 空正文的用法错误, 含制表符或换行的正文, 并发写入: `PRODUCT.md` 未定义, 不在本轮范围.

## 共用规则

### 只读检查

这是纯 CLI, 没有常驻进程, 不监听端口. 不要找端口或 PID, 也不要后台启动 `notes.sh`.

开工前只读确认:

```bash
cd /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
test -x notes.sh
./notes.sh status
```

期望: 输出 `notes-cli 0.2.0`, 下一行 `data_path:` 指向数据文件, 退出码 0. 版本号是现场观察值, 不是通过判据; 若版本不是 0.2.0, 记录实际值后继续按 `PRODUCT.md` 的判据跑.

### 隔离数据, 不碰项目里的真实笔记

本配方用 `NOTES_DATA` 指向 `/tmp` 下的临时文件. 这是 README 声明的数据路径开关, 只改数据落点, 不改产品代码; `status` 会打印实际路径, 用它确认隔离生效.

硬规则:

- 本配方所有 `add` / `show` 都必须带已导出的 `NOTES_DATA`.
- 不要运行不带 `NOTES_DATA` 的 `./notes.sh add`, 否则会写项目内 `data/items.txt`.
- 不要删除或改写项目内已有的 `data/items.txt`; 本次验证不需要碰它.
- 不修改 `notes.sh`, `README.md`, `docs/`, 测试或配置; 不安装工具链.

### 取证

每条命令的标准输出, 标准错误, 退出码都落到 `$EVID/<用例名>.out|.err|.code`. 断言命令的结果落到 `$EVID/<用例名>.check`. 最后生成 `summary.txt`. 证据目录在临时运行目录内, 清理前必须打印或抄录到交付报告.

### 清理

清理只删本次临时目录 `$RUN`, 保留 `.agents/skills/verify-notes-cli/`. 清理后必须用 `git status --porcelain` 和 `git diff --stat` 对照改动范围.

## 准备

从这一节开始按顺序执行, 不要跳节; 中途换了 shell 就从准备段重来, 否则空数据用例会失真.

```bash
PROJ=/tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
RUN=/tmp/verify-notes-cli-run
rm -rf "$RUN"
mkdir -p "$RUN/evidence"
EVID="$RUN/evidence"
export NOTES_DATA="$RUN/items.txt"
cd "$PROJ"
set +e

./notes.sh status >"$EVID/status.out" 2>"$EVID/status.err"
echo $? >"$EVID/status.code"
cat "$EVID/status.out"
test "$(cat "$EVID/status.code")" = 0
grep -Fx "data_path: $NOTES_DATA" "$EVID/status.out"
```

期望: `status.code` 为 `0`; `status.out` 含 `notes-cli 0.2.0`, 且 `data_path:` 正好是 `$RUN/items.txt`. 最后一条 `grep` 退出码 0, 证明隔离数据路径生效.

`$RUN` 是新建的空目录, `$RUN/items.txt` 此时不存在, 满足"从空数据启动".

## 入口 1: 空数据查看

前置: 准备段已执行, `$RUN/items.txt` 不存在或为空.

```bash
cd /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
RUN=/tmp/verify-notes-cli-run; EVID="$RUN/evidence"; export NOTES_DATA="$RUN/items.txt"

set +e
./notes.sh show >"$EVID/show-empty.out" 2>"$EVID/show-empty.err"
rc=$?
echo "$rc" >"$EVID/show-empty.code"

cat "$EVID/show-empty.out"
{
  test "$rc" = 0
  grep -qFx '(empty)' "$EVID/show-empty.out"
  test ! -s "$EVID/show-empty.err"
} >"$EVID/show-empty.check" 2>&1
echo "check_exit=$?"
```

期望: `show-empty.out` 只有一行 `(empty)`; `show-empty.code` 为 `0`; `show-empty.err` 为空; `show-empty.check` 里没有报错, 最后一行 `check_exit=0`.

如果 `check_exit` 不是 0, 把 `$EVID/show-empty.check` 原文留下, 判为未通过, 继续跑后面的入口以便一次收齐证据.

## 入口 2: 记录一条笔记

前置: 入口 1 已跑完, 数据文件仍为空.

```bash
cd /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
RUN=/tmp/verify-notes-cli-run; EVID="$RUN/evidence"; export NOTES_DATA="$RUN/items.txt"

TEXT='第一条笔记'
set +e
./notes.sh add "$TEXT" >"$EVID/add-1.out" 2>"$EVID/add-1.err"
rc=$?
echo "$rc" >"$EVID/add-1.code"

cat "$EVID/add-1.out"
{
  test "$rc" = 0
  grep -qFx "added: $TEXT" "$EVID/add-1.out"
  test ! -s "$EVID/add-1.err"
} >"$EVID/add-1.check" 2>&1
echo "check_exit=$?"
```

期望: `add-1.out` 只有一行 `added: 第一条笔记`; `add-1.code` 为 `0`; `add-1.err` 为空; `check_exit=0`.

紧接着确认这条正文出现在列表末尾:

```bash
cd /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
RUN=/tmp/verify-notes-cli-run; EVID="$RUN/evidence"; export NOTES_DATA="$RUN/items.txt"

set +e
./notes.sh show >"$EVID/show-after-add-1.out" 2>"$EVID/show-after-add-1.err"
rc=$?
echo "$rc" >"$EVID/show-after-add-1.code"
printf '1\t第一条笔记\n' >"$EVID/show-after-add-1.expected"

cat -T "$EVID/show-after-add-1.out"
{
  test "$rc" = 0
  diff -u "$EVID/show-after-add-1.expected" "$EVID/show-after-add-1.out"
} >"$EVID/show-after-add-1.check" 2>&1
echo "check_exit=$?"
```

期望: `check_exit=0`; `cat -T` 显示 `1^I第一条笔记` (`^I` 表示真实的制表符, 不是两个字符); 列表最后一行就是刚加的正文.

## 入口 3: 多条笔记的编号与顺序

前置: 入口 2 已通过, 当前恰有 1 条笔记.

再追加两条, 最后一次性核对完整列表:

```bash
cd /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
RUN=/tmp/verify-notes-cli-run; EVID="$RUN/evidence"; export NOTES_DATA="$RUN/items.txt"

add_and_check() {
  n=$1; text=$2
  set +e
  ./notes.sh add "$text" >"$EVID/add-$n.out" 2>"$EVID/add-$n.err"
  rc=$?
  echo "$rc" >"$EVID/add-$n.code"
  {
    test "$rc" = 0
    grep -qFx "added: $text" "$EVID/add-$n.out"
    test ! -s "$EVID/add-$n.err"
  } >"$EVID/add-$n.check" 2>&1
  echo "add-$n check_exit=$?"
}

add_and_check 2 '第二条笔记'
add_and_check 3 '第三条笔记'

set +e
./notes.sh show >"$EVID/show-final.out" 2>"$EVID/show-final.err"
rc=$?
echo "$rc" >"$EVID/show-final.code"
printf '1\t第一条笔记\n2\t第二条笔记\n3\t第三条笔记\n' >"$EVID/show-final.expected"

cat -T "$EVID/show-final.out"
{
  test "$rc" = 0
  diff -u "$EVID/show-final.expected" "$EVID/show-final.out"
  test ! -s "$EVID/show-final.err"
  test "$(wc -l <"$NOTES_DATA")" = 3
} >"$EVID/show-final.check" 2>&1
echo "show-final check_exit=$?"
```

期望: 两次 `add` 的 `check_exit=0`; `show-final check_exit=0`; `cat -T` 依次显示:

```
1^I第一条笔记
2^I第二条笔记
3^I第三条笔记
```

这同时证明序号从 1 连续递增, 顺序与实际记录一致, 每行是 `<序号>` + 制表符 + `<正文>`.

## 汇总证据

```bash
cd /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
RUN=/tmp/verify-notes-cli-run; EVID="$RUN/evidence"

{
  echo "=== status ==="; cat "$EVID/status.out"; echo "status_exit=$(cat "$EVID/status.code")"
  for name in show-empty add-1 show-after-add-1 add-2 add-3 show-final; do
    echo "=== $name stdout ==="; cat "$EVID/$name.out"
    echo "=== $name code ==="; cat "$EVID/$name.code" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no code file)"
    echo "=== $name err ==="; cat "$EVID/$name.err" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no err file)"
    echo "=== $name check ==="; cat "$EVID/$name.check" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no check file)"
  done
  echo "=== git status ==="; git status --porcelain
  echo "=== git diff stat ==="; git diff --stat
} >"$EVID/summary.txt"

cat "$EVID/summary.txt"
```

交付报告里贴 `summary.txt` 的关键输出, 并写明 `$RUN` 的绝对路径. 证据在清理后会删除, 先抄录再清理.

## 清理与范围对照

```bash
cd /tmp/orchestra-17/proj-create
RUN=/tmp/verify-notes-cli-run

rm -rf "$RUN"
test ! -e "$RUN" && echo "temp_removed=yes"

echo "=== git status --porcelain ==="
git status --porcelain
echo "=== git diff --stat ==="
git diff --stat
```

期望:

- `temp_removed=yes`.
- `git status --porcelain` 只出现 `.agents/skills/verify-notes-cli/` (未跟踪) 或为空, 不得出现 `data/`, `notes.sh`, `README.md`, `docs/` 等改动.
- `git diff --stat` 为空.

若出现范围外改动, 停下报告, 不要用 `git checkout` 或删除文件掩盖; 由用户决定如何处理.

## 未验证与边界

- 本配方不使用项目默认数据路径 `data/items.txt`, 因此不检验默认路径下的真实笔记内容. 这是有意的隔离, 避免测试写入污染用户数据; 默认路径只在 `status` 里只读观察.

# notes-cli 产品说明

状态: 已确认 (2026-10-20, 产品负责人确认). 本文件是本轮唯一通过判据来源.

## 功能: 记录笔记

- 入口: `./notes.sh add <正文>`
- 通过: 退出码 0; 输出 `added: <正文>`; 之后 `show` 能在列表末尾看到这条正文.

## 功能: 查看笔记

- 入口: `./notes.sh show`
- 通过: 每行输出 `<序号>\t<正文>`, 序号从 1 连续递增, 顺序与实际记录一致; 没有记录时输出 `(empty)` 且退出码 0.

## 非目标

- 导出 (`export`) 不在本轮覆盖范围.
=====NOTES.SH=====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
DATA=${NOTES_DATA:-$ROOT/data/items.txt}
cmd=${1:-}
case $cmd in
  add)
    text=${2:-}
    if [ -z "$text" ]; then echo "usage: notes.sh add <text>" >&2; exit 2; fi
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DATA")"
    printf '%s\n' "$text" >> "$DATA"
    echo "added: $text"
    ;;
  show)
    if [ ! -s "$DATA" ]; then echo "(empty)"; exit 0; fi
    i=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      i=$((i + 1))
      printf '%s\t%s\n' "$i" "$line"
    done < "$DATA"
    ;;
  status)
    echo "notes-cli 0.2.0"
    echo "data_path: $DATA"
    ;;
  export)
    out=${2:-}
    if [ -z "$out" ]; then echo "usage: notes.sh export <path>" >&2; exit 2; fi
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
    cp "$DATA" "$out" 2>/dev/null || : > "$out"
    echo "exported to $out"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: notes.sh <add|show|status|export>" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
